title: PAMS: Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.28476v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization provides a computationally efficient approach to fine-tuning large language models (LLMs), but conventional methods typically rely on isotropic perturbations that ignore the anisotropic structure of neural-network parameter spaces. We introduce Preconditioned Activation-Metric Subspace (PAMS), a ZO optimization framework that uses forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries without computing gradients or forming dense curvature matrices. PAMS tracks a low-rank approximation of the dominant activation subspace and its associated spectrum online, and uses the spectrum to softly reweight perturbation variance while preserving exploration in directions outside the retained subspace. translated_title: PAMS：用于零阶大语言模型微调的预条件激活度量子空间
translated_abstract: 零阶（ZO）优化为微调大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种计算高效的方法，但传统方法通常依赖于各向同性扰动，忽略了神经网络参数空间的各向异性结构。我们提出了预条件激活度量子空间（PAMS），这是一种零阶优化框架，利用前向传播的激活统计量来构建结构化的、逐层的扰动几何，而无需计算梯度或构建稠密的曲率矩阵。PAMS在线跟踪主导激活子空间的低秩近似及其相关谱，并利用该谱对扰动方差进行软重加权，同时在保留子空间之外的方向上保持探索能力。迹归一化将扰动几何与其整体尺度分离开来，使得各层之间的扰动幅度保持一致。我们从理论上证明了所得到的……
tldr: PAMS提出了一种新的零阶优化框架，利用前向传播的激活统计量在线构建结构化的逐层扰动几何，无需梯度或曲率矩阵即可实现更高效的大语言模型免梯度微调。
en_tdlr: PAMS introduces a zeroth-order optimization framework that uses online forward-pass activation statistics to construct structured, layer-wise perturbation geometries, enabling more effective gradient-free LLM fine-tuning without gradients or curvature matrices.
